expectations.text: No paragraphs: every visible text block is 25 words or fewer
expectations.evidence: 1 blocks over 25 words; longest is 27: "You've taken 87 orders so far, 12% more than last Friday at this time. 12 are in the kitchen or wait"

expectations.text: Explanations and tips are on demand: popups reveal 30+ words
expectations.evidence: 9 popups revealed 660 words; 714 words always visible

expectations.text: Info popups open on click or tap, not hover only
expectations.evidence: 9 of 9 info triggers opened via click

expectations.text: Type scale: 3 text sizes or fewer (display, body, caption)
Accent discipline: saturated color covers 10% of the page or less
At most 4 color families (one accent plus good, warning, bad)
